description: Create pixel art and export animation sheets with metadata.
longDescription: Create or refine editable pixel art with a local Aseprite installation, export PNG sheets with JSON animation metadata, and check them in the target engine.
example.1: Create a small animated pixel-art game asset with editable Aseprite source and a PNG/JSON export.
example.2: Export this Aseprite animation for the project and verify its frame timing and tags.
